briefdescription.para: Return the LLVM name for an intrinsic, such as "llvm.ppc.altivec.lvx".

detaileddescription.para: Note, this version is for intrinsics with no overloads. Use the other version of getName if overloads are required.

briefdescription.para: Return the LLVM name for an intrinsic, without encoded types for overloading, such as "llvm.ssa.copy".

memberdef.name: getName

briefdescription.para: Return the LLVM name for an intrinsic, such as "llvm.ppc.altivec.lvx" or "llvm.ssa.copy.p0s_s.1".

detaileddescription.para: Note, this version of getName supports overloads. This is less efficient than the StringRef version of this function. If no overloads are required, it is safe to use this version, but better to use the StringRef version. If one of the types is based on an unnamed type, a function type will be computed. Providing FT will avoid this computation.

briefdescription.para: Return the LLVM name for an intrinsic.

detaileddescription.para: This is a special version only to be used by LLVMIntrinsicCopyOverloadedName. It only supports overloads based on named types.

briefdescription.para: Return the function type for an intrinsic.
Returns true if the intrinsic can be overloaded.
isTargetIntrinsic - Returns true if IID is an intrinsic specific to a certain target.

detaileddescription.para: If it is a generic intrinsic false is returned.

briefdescription.para: This does the actual lookup of an intrinsic ID which matches the given function name.
Return the attributes for an intrinsic.
Look up the Function declaration of the intrinsic id in the Module M.

detaileddescription.para: If it does not exist, add a declaration and return it. Otherwise, return the existing declaration.

The Tys parameter is for intrinsics with overloaded types (e.g., those using iAny, fAny, vAny, or pAny). For a declaration of an overloaded intrinsic, Tys must provide exactly one type for each overloaded type in the intrinsic.
